# iccatSALB

`iccatSALB` is an R package supporting the Management Strategy
Evaluation (MSE) for South Atlantic albacore tuna, developed for the
International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT).
It provides the operating models, management procedures, performance
metrics, and all related data and code used to evaluate the candidate
management procedures against a range of plausible operating models for
the stock and fishery.

See the [project homepage](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/) for
an overview of the MSE materials, and the [Trial Specifications
Document](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/tsd/) for full details
of the operating models, management procedures, and performance metrics
used in the MSE.

## Installation

You can install the `iccatSALB` package from its [GitHub
repository](https://github.com/ICCAT/salb-mse) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ICCAT/salb-mse")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Best_Compliant()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Best_Compliant.md)
  : Pick the highest-yield compliant row from a \[Tune_Grid()\] result
- [`Build_MP_Variants()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Build_MP_Variants.md)
  : Build a set of named MP variants from a generator and a parameter
  grid
- [`Build_OM_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Build_OM_Grid.md)
  : Build a reference operating model grid specification
- [`Calc_PM_Stats()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Calc_PM_Stats.md)
  : Per-simulation values for the standard PM panel
- [`Calc_PMs()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Calc_PMs.md)
  : Tabulate a standard set of performance metrics, for comparing CMPs
- [`Cap_TAC_Change()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Cap_TAC_Change.md)
  : Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC
  recommendation
- [`Downweight_Index()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Downweight_Index.md)
  : Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3
  control file
- [`Downweight_Index_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Downweight_Index_Grid.md)
  : Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey
  index
- [`Extract_MSE_Timeseries()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Extract_MSE_Timeseries.md)
  : Tidy per-simulation, per-year SB/SBMSY, F/FMSY, and Yield time
  series
- [`GetHistFiles()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/GetHistFiles.md)
  : List saved Hist files for a projection run
- [`GetMSEFiles()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/GetMSEFiles.md)
  : List MSE files and build an OM index
- [`Import_OM_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Import_OM_Grid.md)
  : Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects
- [`Modify_Growth_M()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Modify_Growth_M.md)
  : Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control
  file
- [`PM_Depletion_Min()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_Depletion_Min.md)
  : Lowest depletion (SB/SB0) reached during a performance-metric window
- [`PM_Ratio_Mean()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_Ratio_Mean.md)
  : Mean SB/SBMSY or F/FMSY ratio over a performance-metric window
- [`PM_Window_Years()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_Window_Years.md)
  : Resolve a named performance-metric year window
- [`PM_Years()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_Years.md)
  : Restrict performance-metric years to those on/after an OM's
  MPStartYear
- [`Prepare_OM_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Prepare_OM_Grid.md)
  : Prepare SS3 run directories for an operating model grid
- [`Run_SS3_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Run_SS3_Grid.md)
  : Run SS3 across a set of model directories in parallel
- [`Simulate_OM_Dir()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Simulate_OM_Dir.md)
  : Simulate historical dynamics for a directory of operating models
- [`Tune_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Tune_Grid.md)
  : Project a set of MP variants and tabulate performance metrics in one
  call
- [`Write_MP_Variants()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Write_MP_Variants.md)
  : Write named MP-variant definitions into a CMP-definition script
